title: Signs in block variants
summary: Builders can now add signs as block variant options in the editor, give them text, and pick how they hang.
highlights: A sign can be one of a cell's block options, with its own text or one text shared by every sign in the cell
Choose how it is mounted: on a wall, standing, hanging, on a wall bracket, or Auto to fit whatever is around it
Write the front and back, pick a text colour and glow, and wax it so passengers can't change it
